details: The effective range distinguishes every pair of hypotheses, so its restriction leaves at most one hypothesis consistent with any target labeling.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Lemma `lem:effective-range-xtd`.
name: Effective Range / Extended Teaching Dimension
witness_verification: For #classes/halfintervals with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n-1$ and $2$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
